decisions.reason: As a newly launched camera tightly aligned with our core space optics business and given long space-market qualification cycles, we would keep this option open because uncertainty has not resolved enough to justify exit.

Its modular navigation camera concept fits our strategic direction toward flexible spacecraft sensors, so for a large R&D-intensive firm the cost of keeping it on offer is low relative to its option value.

Although a sensor suite is somewhat broader and more uncertain than a single component, it still builds on our established capabilities and the early market evidence is too limited to warrant abandonment.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor is strategically relevant but appears less commercially established on the website, so it has the highest withdrawal risk, yet we would still retain it because compact sensors for future spacecraft remain a valuable option.
